slug: 2026-02-13 Chad Plans 50 Telecom Sites, 50 km of Fiber in N'Djamena

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports the Trans-Saharan Fiber Optic Backbone (DTS), a key part of Chad's regional interconnection strategy with planned links to Niger, Nigeria, Algeria, Libya and Egypt, is 60% complete.
facts.system: Trans-Saharan Fiber Optic Backbone (Dorsale Transsaharienne, DTS)

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports other projects under way include rehabilitation of the fibre optic link between N'Djamena and Mbere to diversify international connectivity routes via Cameroon.

systems.system: Trans-Saharan Fiber Optic Backbone (Dorsale Transsaharienne, DTS)
